_comment: The Pip (lqe, LANA.cpp) build the client packages at <resources>/pip (electron-pip-supervisor.js), built by scripts/build-pip.sh on a matching computer with LANA.cpp's distribution contract. The v3.0.0 tag was MOVED on 2026-11-12T13:38:39Z from d857fbf10556 to this commit (adds --gpu-inexact: batched decode and shared system-prompt state on the GPU; LANA-AI infra/lib/config/lqe.pin.js LQE_COMMIT). The tag name alone cannot tell a build before a move from one after, so scripts/build-pip.sh refuses a checkout whose v3.0.0 resolves to any other commit (fetch with git fetch --tags --force). Change the commit only together with a rebuild of every platform's sha256.
